2. Heard Sri Vinay Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Kapil Tyagi, learned counsel for the first informant and Sri Bade Lal Bind, learned counsel for the State and perused the material on record.
3 . Office to trace out the vakalatnama of Sri Tyagi which is filed in the office on 06.09.2023 and place it on record and make a note in the order sheet.

4. This bail application under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant Asif, seeking enlargement on bail during trial in connection with Case Crime No. 0158 of 2023, under Sections 452, 376(3), 504, 506, 328 IPC and 3/4 of POCSO Act, 2012 and 3(2)(v)
SC/ST Act, registered at P.S. Simbhawali, District Hapur.

sentences.text:
The case of the prosecution as per the FIR lodged on 08.05.2023 by Bhikhari against the applicant and three other persons is that on 04.05.2023 at about 01:00 am Asif his neighbour entered in his house from the roof and tried to commit rape upon his daughter aged about 15 years who opposes it and raised a shout on which the wife of the informant came there and on seeing her,
the applicant ran away by extending threats.

His daughter then while crying told his wife that on 01.02.2023 when they had gone in the death of a relative, the applicant came to the house and gave some sweets/barfi and after consuming it she became semiconscious and then the applicant committed rape upon her and captured her photographs and on threat, he committed rape upon her.
On a complaint to his family members, caste relates words used against him.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case as he had a quarrel with the first informant and had moved an application before the SHO concerned on 29.01.2023.

It is argued that the doctor conducting the medical examination of the victim, did not find any injury either on her body or private parts and as such medical corroboration of the alleged incident is not there.
It is argued that the First Information Report has been lodged after about three months from the date of the alleged allegation of rape of the victim.
It is argued that during investigation no objectionable video or photographs have been recovered by the police.
It is argued that charge sheet in the matter has been submitted and as such there are no chances of the applicant tampering with evidence or threatening the witnesses.
He further argued that the applicant has no criminal history as stated in para 23 of the affidavit and is in jail since 10.05.2023.

7. Per contra, learned counsel for the first informant and learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for bail and argued that the victim as per the High School Marksheet aged about 15 years and 4 months as her date of birth is recorded therein as 06.01.2008.
It is argued that there is an allegation against the applicant in the FIR, statements of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. of committing rape upon her.

It is argued that in so far as the delay in lodging of the FIR is concerned although the incident dated 01.02.2023 was not reported immediately as there was threat extended by the applicant after which on 04.05.2023 again the applicant attempted to commit rape upon her and then the First Information Report has been lodged.
It is argued that the victim is a minor girl.
It is argued that there is no reason for false implication of the applicant and as such the prayer for bail of the applicant be rejected.
8. After having heard learned counsels for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that as per High School Marksheet, the victim is a minor.
The applicant is named in the FIR, statements of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C.
The delay in so far as is concerned, the first incident of 01.02.2023 was although not reported immediately but the after the second incident of 04.05.2023 the present FIR has been lodged.
Since the victim is a minor and there are allegations against the applicant, I do not find it a fit case for bail.
9. Considering the totality of the case in particular, nature of evidence available on record, I am not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
10. The bail application is, accordingly, rejected.
